Aspora / Plus91

NRI life. No instruction manual.

A playful studio format that makes an unfamiliar brand feel easy to step into.

Client / PlatformAspora
The workVisual identity · Content strategy · Production

The idea in practice.

Plus91 invites people to guess different parts of NRI life: where someone lives, how long they have been abroad, and the experiences that connect them.

The long-form series is fast, studio-shot, and led by culture. It gives finance-adjacent content a friendly entry point through people, participation, and shared experiences.

For a finance brand, the conversation can begin with the life around the money.
